config._note: rostering (2026-07-14): the publishable roster header. Unlike PayrollRun, Roster carries a REAL x-openregister-lifecycle (concept <-> gepubliceerd via publiceren/intrekken), so RosterDetail legitimately renders a lifecycleActions widget for exactly those two transitions -- no invented edge (the AttendanceRecordDetail sluiten/heropenen precedent). The 'Rooster' data widget carries period/administrationId/status; Related resolves and links the optional orgUnitId scope (excluded from data). The page-level 'ATW-controle' api-call action posts {rosterId: @objectId} to POST /api/roster/check (guarded server-side by RosterController::authorizeRoster()) and surfaces the Arbeidstijdenwet verdict over the roster's assignments regardless of publish status -- publishing itself is NOT hard-blocked on a violation (guard wiring is hrmq-rule-compliance-enforcement's scope, design.md Non-Goal). The FK-scoped 'Roosterindelingen' child object-list (RosterAssignment.rosterId = @objectId) is the plan itself. No stat KPI -- a header has no numeric headline. Audit history is a sidebar tab.

params.title: Shifts
params.description: Reusable shift definitions (clock shape): name, start and end time (HH:MM), break and optional organisational unit. An end time not later than the start time indicates a night shift crossing midnight.

params.title: Shift
params.note: rostering (2026-07-14): a reusable shift definition (klok-vorm template), authored once and reused across many RosterAssignments. The 'Dienst' data widget carries name/startTime/endTime/breakMinutes/active; the 'Related' panel resolves and links the optional orgUnitId scope (excluded from the data widget, the EmployeeDetail exclude convention). No lifecycleActions: Shift carries no x-openregister-lifecycle -- a plain record toggled active/inactive, not a workflow (OrgUnitDetail precedent). No stat/files/comms leaves -- a template definition has no numeric headline aggregate or document. Audit history is a sidebar tab.

params.title: Rosters
params.description: Publishable rosters per planning period: a draft -> published lifecycle, with the Working Hours Act check over the planned roster assignments per roster.

actions.label: Create roster
actions.successMessage: Draft roster created. Add roster assignments and run the working hours check before you publish.

params.title: Roster assignments
params.description: Planned roster assignments: an employee on a shift on a date within a roster, with the projected plannedStart/plannedEnd for the Working Hours Act check. Date-sorted (the MVP planning view; a visual planning board is a Non-Goal).

params.title: Roster assignment
params.note: rostering (2026-07-14): one employee x one shift x one date within a Roster. The 'Roosterindeling' data widget carries date/plannedStart/plannedEnd/plannedBreakMinutes -- the projected planned-clock fields the ATW check reads -- excluding rosterId/employeeId/shiftId (Related resolves and links all three by name, the EmployeeDetail exclude convention) and userId (the internal @me self-service copy). No lifecycleActions: the assignment carries no approval status of its own -- the plan's only lifecycle lives on the Roster header (design D1). No stat/files/comms leaves. Audit history is a sidebar tab.
